Name: Kenneth's Vanilla Fish Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Vanilla Fish Addon[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Hate waiting for the right season, weather, and time just to catch one fish? Now you can buy them all![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What it does:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🐟 50+ Vanilla Fish added to Kenneth's Grocery Store (Shop 3) - all year-round![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]🎣 Ocean & River Fish: Anchovy, Tuna, Sardine, Bream, Bass, Trout, Salmon, Perch, Carp, Catfish, Pike, Sunfish, Red Mullet, Herring, Eel, Octopus, Red Snapper, Squid, Flounder, Midnight Carp, Stingray, Lionfish, Blue Discus, Midnight Squid, Spook Fish, Blobfish & more![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]🦀 Crab Pot: Crab, Cockle, Mussel, Shrimp, Snail, Periwinkle, Oyster, Clam, Lobster, Crayfish, Sea Cucumber, Super Cucumber[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]👻 Special & Legendary: Ghostfish, Stonefish, Crimsonfish, Angler, Ice Pip, Lava Eel, Legend, Sandfish, Scorpion Carp, Void Salmon[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]💰 Premium price for balance, so it won't replace fishing. For bundles, cooking, gifts & late-game convenience![/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Perfect for:[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]• Community Center Bundles - when you're missing just one fish[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]• Cooking recipes (Sashimi, Fish Taco, etc.)[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]• Gifts for villagers who love fish[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]• Players who hate the fishing minigame![/size][/b]

[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Grocery Store (Required)[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ [/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Lightweight & Balanced - no new items, just vanilla fish in Kenneth's Grocery Store![/size][/b]
